egress.terms: No traffic allowance or price is stated on the bot's page.

interface_detail: A Telegram chat with the bot; the result is a link or a file delivered into the chat. No HTTP API is published.

chaining: A fetch-and-deliver bot: a URL or torrent a user cannot fetch directly becomes a file in the chat, up to the stated 4GB.
binding_note: The only number that can be named from evidence is the per-file ceiling; the bot publishes no quota.
